profile.name: Zetian Tao
profile.headline: Student at Loyola Marymount University
profile.summary: A Bachelor of Business Administration student at Loyola Marymount University, majoring in Finance and Information Systems and Business Analytics, expected to graduate in May 2027.
profile.bio:
I'm interested in both sides of a business: what the numbers say, and the systems that produce them. That's why I study Finance alongside Information Systems at LMU.
My internships run from IPO due diligence at Guotai Junan Securities and equity research at Tiger Brokers to demand forecasting at Jiaxing Xinchengda Fashion and data governance at Guardian Regulatory Consulting.
I went to high school in Shanghai before moving to Los Angeles for college, and I built and run this website myself on Railway with PostgreSQL.

highlights: SEC EDGAR Data Pipeline & Earnings Analytics
